answer: Lotus Draw Assignment: each agent gets a slot from a public randomness beacon emitted after registration closes, mapping identities to shards no one can predict beforehand. Agents must wander across shards to transact, so fake identities scatter thinly and rarely meet real counterparties before dawn of the next epoch, when unused slots expire and registration fees are forfeited. Each sybil therefore pays a full fee plus lost epoch yield while earning almost no transaction volume.
